## Risks and scope

## Contributor checklist

- [ ] This PR is focused and makes a concrete improvement.
- [ ] I preserved or explained the relationship between source Markdown and rendered HTML.
- [ ] I have not claimed tests, approval, deployment, or funding eligibility that were not verified.
- [ ] I have not committed credentials, personal records, confidential evidence, or unauthorized assets.
- [ ] I have read [CONTRIBUTING.md](../CONTRIBUTING.md) and [contributor safety and governance](../CONTRIBUTOR_SAFETY_AND_GOVERNANCE.md).

Constructive technical disagreement is welcome. Please describe evidence and an actionable path forward; avoid personal judgments.
